description: Source code for the ParameterManagerWrapper class, which manages audio policy parameters and criteria in Android's audio framework, including device connection states, force use configurations, and criteria for input/output devices and telephony mode.

classes.name: ParameterMgrPlatformConnectorLogger
classes.description: Logger class implementing CParameterMgrPlatformConnector::ILogger for logging info and warnings.

classes.name: ParameterManagerWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper class managing audio policy parameters, criteria, and configurations in Android.

methods.name: ParameterManagerWrapper
methods.description: Constructor initializing the parameter manager with schema validation and configuration files.

methods.name: addCriterion
methods.description: Adds a selection criterion with specified name, inclusivity, value pairs, and default value.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the parameter manager and validates schema if enabled.

methods.name: getElement
methods.description: Template method to retrieve a parameter element by name from a map.

methods.name: isStarted
methods.description: Checks if the parameter manager has been started.

methods.name: setPhoneState
methods.description: Sets the current phone (telephony) mode criterion.

methods.name: getPhoneState
methods.description: Retrieves the current phone (telephony) mode criterion.

methods.name: setForceUse
methods.description: Sets the force use configuration for a given usage type.

methods.name: getForceUse
methods.description: Gets the current force use configuration for a given usage type.

methods.name: setDeviceConnectionState
methods.description: Updates the connection state of a device (connected/disconnected).

methods.name: applyPlatformConfiguration
methods.description: Applies current configuration to the platform.

methods.name: convertDeviceTypeToCriterionValue
methods.description: Converts a device type to its criterion value representation.

methods.name: convertDeviceTypesToCriterionValue
methods.description: Converts a set of device types to a combined criterion value.

methods.name: convertDeviceCriterionValueToDeviceTypes
methods.description: Converts a criterion value back to a set of device types.
